description: This file defines a REST controller for managing user labels, including CRUD operations and label assignment to emails, within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: LabelController
classes.description: REST controller handling label CRUD and assignment operations, secured by user authentication.

methods.name: currentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on Authentication object.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns paginated list of labels owned by the current user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new label for the current user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the name and/or color of a specified label.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a label by its ID.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Assigns labels to a specified email.

methods.name: unassign
methods.description: Removes labels from a specified email.

methods.name: emailsByLabel
methods.description: Lists emails associated with a specific label, paginated.
